profile.org_note: Flat structure: an Irvine corporate team (CEO Matt Zaist, CFO Rob Irwin, COO John Bohnen, GC Miek Harbur, EVP Investments Matt Gibson) over 11 division presidents by state/metro; no regional-president layer is published. Land and capital decisions run through an investment committee (Irwin and Gibson are members); Gibson sets investment strategy, capital allocation and project capitalization and oversees the local acquisition teams, so he and Irwin are the land-banking contacts. Apollo designees (Peter Sinensky, Alex Liao) sit as directors.
profile.summary: Apollo-backed private builder formed when New Home Co. (Irvine) bought public Landsea Homes (Dallas) for $11.30/share cash in June 2025 and rebranded both as Risewell Homes on 2025-12-02: roughly 4,000 homes a year, 120+ selling communities and 28,000+ controlled lots across 11 markets in CA, AZ, CO, OR, WA, TX and FL. Already a land-bank user: Millrose Properties took $522M of New Home homesites under option at the Landsea closing, and the company funds itself with Apollo equity plus senior notes.

Treasurer / capital-markets head below the CFO: not publicly disclosed (CFO Rob Irwin owns capital-markets transactions per his bio).

Division land acquisition / land development VPs: not publicly disclosed. Land runs through EVP Investments Matt Gibson's 'local acquisition teams by submarket'; a 'Land Company' president (A.J. Jarvis) appears only in an unverified third-party directory.
Bay Area: Tom Baine was Bay Area Division President on the 2025-12-25 page; by the 2026-03-30 page the seat is listed under Matt Gibson. Whether Baine left or moved is not public.
